visualCharacteristics: Research row: an intro (coloured kicker heading, lead, text, data-source line) above three chart columns, each with a coloured chart title, chart image and note.
contentPattern: Row 1 intro: h2 kicker, lead paragraph, text paragraphs, source paragraph with link; rows 2..n: one chart each (title paragraph, chart image, note paragraph).
usage: Use to present a research finding with an introductory text and a row of supporting charts.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for data-story sections by authoring one intro row and one row per chart, picking a colour option.
